# SP Reset Scroll

*Takes back every skill point spent on your job's attacks. They return to level 1, and the points can be spent again.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Resets your skill points |
| Sells for | 100 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [Orange Mushroom](../monsters/orange_mushroom.md) (0.15%)
- Dropped by [Pig](../monsters/pig.md) (0.15%)
